business_scope.primary_industry_name: Direct Online Retail of Portable Battery Generators and Solar Panels

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with constitutional and commercial statutory overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA) in force since 15 May 2012
OECD BEPS Inclusive Framework membership application to DTAAs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1621 de 2013 (modifying Código de Comercio Articles 97 and 98); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1067 de 2015 (Title 4, Sections 4.1 and 4.2); Circular Básica Jurídica de la Superintendencia de Sociedades (Circular Externa 100-000005 de 2021 and updated 2023); Decreto 2271 de 2023 on beneficial ownership reporting; Ley 526 de 1999 and UIAF Resolutions 1025/2020, 303/2021; Ley 1762 de 2015 (AML/CFT criminalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Articles of Association (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal or Escritura Pública de Constitución)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs) for documents originating abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Legal Existence for the foreign entity (when branch or representative office is involved)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Companies Registry of the foreign jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the foreign issuing state; alternatively consular legalization at Colombian Embassy/Consulate for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration form (Formato de Beneficiario Final) with sworn statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) – DIAN and Superintendencia de Sociedades
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notary acknowledgement (notarial recognition) in Colombia; apostille not required for domestic documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of shareholders' passports or identity documents (if foreign shareholders act in person)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National consulate or apostille authority of the shareholder's home country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of physical registered office (lease or property title, or notarized declaration of domicile acceptance)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary 1, 2, etc. of the chosen municipality / commercial registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory positive identification of every shareholder and beneficial owner against Colombian Listas Vinculantes (UIAF/National Treasury OFAC-equivalent internal lists), UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions, and domestic Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) databases maintained by UIAF; ongoing transaction monitoring and enhanced due diligence for any PEP-linked direct or indirect owner; record retention for at least ten (10) years from the termination of business relationship; immediate Freeze Report (Reporte de Congelamiento) filing with UIAF within 24 hours upon sanctions match.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – online pre-approval via www.rues.org.co and Chamber of Commerce electronic system (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or transliterated into Spanish; must follow the required structure of [denomination] + 'S.A.S.'; must be lawful, distinctive, not contrary to public order, and not deceptive; commerce names may include Spanish transliteration of a foreign brand but the official legal name must be in the local alphabet; names that use only foreign-language generic descriptors are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On name rejection, the applicant may file an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Chamber of Commerce within ten (10) business days of receipt of rejection notice, accompanied by a corrected or alternative name; if denied, the applicant may file a subsidiario/appeal before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within one (1) month; alternatively, the applicant can reserve a new name through the RUES portal, which requires no further ministerial review if the token restrictions are resolved.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual and co-working addresses are generally accepted only if the address is a physical Colombian address and the S.A.S. can be located for official notifications and inspections; flexible office arrangements are permitted, but the registered office must be identifiable in the Chamber of Commerce registry; online-only e-commerce businesses under ISIC 4791 may use a registered agent's physical address, provided the agent contractually accepts service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium (about 25-35% in first two years) – Superintendencia de Sociedades and municipal authorities conduct random compliance inspections of registered offices of newly formed S.A.S. companies, especially those reporting e-commerce income with third-party payment processors such as Stripe or Affirm BNPL; the risk increases to ~50% if the corporate address is a virtual office at a commercial business center.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-approval of company name (Certificado de Homonimia) via RUES / Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá or competent local chamber
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (fixed fee published by the Chamber; approx. USD 8)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Public deed of incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) if shareholders choose formal deed; otherwise private deed with notarial acknowledgment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial scale (arancel notarial) depending on capital; benchmark USD 30–60

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Superintendencia de Sociedades registration of incorporation and UBO form
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (approx. USD 0.5% of subscribed capital for low capital, capped; USD 50 benchmark)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration of S.A.S. articles with Chamber of Commerce (including registration tax ICA and registry fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on capital: base registration fee approx. USD 40 plus proportionate registration tax (0.5%–1.1% of capital); benchmark USD 100 for minimum capital S.A.S.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-operational tax registration with DIAN (NIT plus RUT) including e-invoicing setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration fee and data entry in RUB (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No separate statutory fee; included in annual RUES renewal (approx. USD 20 if filed via agent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial recognition and apostille of foreign incorporation documents of shareholders (if any)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / local notary

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent / virtual office lease for first pre-incorporation year (optional, if no physical lease)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Private sector legal service provider / co-working operator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark USD 250–600/year for registered address in Bogotá

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT compliance onboarding software and PEP screening setup (one-time)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; custom low-risk e-commerce screening tool

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel fee for incorporation and due diligence dossier (attorney, bogotá market)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International business law firm / local abogado
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat fee for standard S.A.S. incorporation with AML review (USD 500–900)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. Act), Article 5; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 98-118 and 354; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (business registration regulation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Chamber of Commerce) via the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Certificate of Incorporation) recorded in the Mercantile Registry; a public deed is only required where real property is contributed
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 1258 de 2008; at least one share must be subscribed and the contribution payment may be deferred for up to 24 months from incorporation; capital may be expressed in cash or in-kind
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: First Board Resolution. Unanimous consent of the Founding Shareholder: (1) RATIFIES the subscription of all authorized shares and approves the capital contribution payment schedule; (2) ADOPTS the registered office at the company's Bogotá D.C. domicile as the statutory seat; (3) APPOINTS the sole Legal Representative with comprehensive representation, contractual, banking, and judicial powers; (4) APPOINTS the Alternate Legal Representative; (5) AUTHORIZES the Legal Representative to file all documents with the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and municipal authorities, to complete RUT registration, open bank accounts, and ratify all preparatory acts performed before this meeting. All resolutions passed unanimously on this date, certified by the corresponding minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal operated by the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the RUES web system, submit up to three proposed corporate names for a clearance search against the Mercantile Registry index; obtain a provisional name reservation certificate valid for thirty days.
required_dossiers: Name search request form
Identification document of the founding shareholder (passport or Colombian cédula)
Preliminary list of proposed corporate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is taken or rejected, file an administrative reconsideration within the reservation window or select an alternative name and re-issue the reservation certificate without additional registry penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Private Incorporation Document with DIAN Pre-Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) online pre-registration module and local notary for optional signature authentication
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in accordance with Ley 1258 de 2008, including corporate purpose coverage for e-commerce and direct retail of portable battery generators and solar panels; execute the document before a notary for voluntary signature authentication; simultaneously submit the Pre-RUT application to DIAN to obtain a provisional NIT.
required_dossiers: Private incorporation document (bylaws and shareholder agreement)
Pre-RUT form submitted to DIAN
Identification documents of all subscribing shareholders
Power of attorney executed by non-resident shareholders, if applicable
Proof of tax residence of foreign shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the Pre-RUT due to documentary inconsistencies, correct the RUT data fields through the DIAN web portal, re-validate the identification documents, and re-file within five business days; no new fees, only statutory interest if the objection pertains to tax ID mismatch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registry Filing at the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Mercantile Registry office (registry desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed private incorporation document with the Chamber of Commerce, pay the applicable registration fee based on subscribed capital and the notary authentication fee, and request issuance of the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal demonstrating the legal incorporation date.
required_dossiers: Executed Documento Privado de Constitución
Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil (Merchant Registration Form)
Comprobante de pago de derechos de inscripción
DIAN Pre-RUT / provisional NIT record
Identification documents of the legal representative and alternate representative
Certified name reservation certificate issued in Step 1
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registry queries must be cured within thirty days; file a written correction, legalize all defective signatures before the notary, and resubmit the amended document; if stalled, escalate to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for a supervisory resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT Registration and Electronic Signature Activation at DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) — RUT process via online service center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the provisional NIT and the Mercantile Registry certificate, complete the definitive RUT registration to activate the company's tax ID, select the applicable tax regime (impuesto de renta, IVA gap analysis for e-commerce, and applicable ICA), and obtain the company's electronic signature for future facturación electrónica and customs filings.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Company NIT (provisional Pre-RUT record)
Shareholder identification documents
Proof of registered office address
Bank deposit slip or online payment proof for any associated fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify inconsistencies in the RUT form online; if the DIAN portal blocks activation pending a documentary audit, present originals at the DIAN jurisdictional office and formally respond to the requerimiento within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License and Sectoral Enablements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda (Bogotá D.C.) for Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA), Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for fire safety, and DIAN for electronic invoicing activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company in the municipal ICA tax roll and obtain the operating permit (registro de industria y comercio), obtain the Certificado de Bomberos covering any storage space for batteries and portable power equipment, and formally enroll the company in the DIAN electronic invoicing system (facturación electrónica) to fulfill tax documentation obligations.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT certificate showing ICA registration
Lease or ownership deed of the registered office and any warehouse spaces
Certificado de Bomberos for storage facilities
Electronic invoicing activation request with company digital certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal queries on ICA registration are corrected by filing an amendment through the local tax agency online portal; if the Bomberos certificate is denied, perform the prescribed fire safety upgrades and re-inspection within fifteen business days; electronic invoicing objections are cured by re-validating the digital certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for consumer safety and business supervision; Ministerio de Minas y Energía for RETIE technical regulation applicable to photovoltaic modules, inverters, and battery chargers; no manufacturing license applies to pure online retail activity
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Mercantile and ICA Operating Registration, integrated with the RETIE Certificate of Conformity for imported solar panels and battery-powered equipment, and mandatory Import Registration for electrical and battery products on the national customs processing system

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) with coordination from the Regional Autonomous Corporation (CAR Cundinamarca) for municipal environmental obligations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category IV — EIA Exempt (online retail and warehousing without industrial transformation; no environmental license is required; however, Extended Producer Responsibility obligations apply under RAEE Resolution 1306 de 2022 for import and sale of battery and electronic products)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emissions are generated. Compliance thresholds: (i) sanitary sewage must comply with municipal sewer standards under Decreto 1076 de 2015; (ii) packaging waste falls under Extended Producer Responsibility take-back obligations; (iii) spent lithium-ion, lithium-iron-phosphate, and damaged batteries must be handled by certified RAEE waste processors under Resolution 1306 de 2022; (iv) any hazardous battery waste transport must comply with Decreto 1609 de 2002.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety clearance) for storage areas containing lithium battery inventory; structural load inspection certification for any racking systems exceeding three meters; occupational health and safety management system (SG-SST) registration under Resolution 0312 de 2019; workplace medical and hygiene clearance as required by the Ministry of Labor for warehouse operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic services through the 'Sede Electrónica DIAN' and Muisca transaction platform (registration, e-invoicing and customs modules).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Execute the S.A.S. private incorporation document (documento privado) with no minimum capital and register the company with the competent Cámara de Comercio in the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE), obtaining the provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) automatically through DIAN's integrated online system; (2) Complete RUT (Registro Único Tributario, Form 2281) registration via Muisca, selecting the status of Responsable de IVA – Régimen Común, Exportador, and Obligado a Facturar Electrónicamente; (3) Appoint a legal representative with Colombian domicile, enrol the non-resident shareholders and final beneficial owners in the RUT, and file the required beneficial-ownership declaration; (4) Acquire a digital certificate from a DIAN-authorized certification authority and either contract a DIAN-approved technological invoicing provider or adopt DIAN's free e-invoicing application; (5) Activate the electronic invoicing 'habilitación' and verify the NIT/CUDE issuance keys before commencing sales.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: S.A.S. is a separate corporate taxpayer subject to Colombian corporate income tax (35%), VAT, ICA and complementary taxes; no pass-through, transparency, or US-style check-the-box election is available to an S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (i) Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE): optional for companies with prior-year gross income below 100,000 UVT (COP 4,706,500,000 for 2024), replacing income tax, incidental gains, ICA and complementary taxes in a single return, while VAT continues to apply separately; (ii) Zona Franca user status: election to operate as Usuario Industrial de Bienes or Usuario Industrial de Servicios within an authorized free-trade zone, subject to DIAN investment and employment requirements, with 20% corporate income tax and specific VAT benefits; (iii) VAT input-credit proration elections and annual regularization for hybrid taxable/excluded activities under Articles 109-112 of the Tax Statute; (iv) Hybrid-mismatch 'check-the-box' mechanisms: not available under Colombian law; the taxpayer must instead comply with BEPS Action 2 reporting (Decree 2120 of 2017) and apply non-deduction or double-withholding adjustments where a hybrid mismatch is detected.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) – Colombian value-added tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Nil for legal entities: an S.A.S. is mandatorily subject to the Régimen Común from incorporation regardless of turnover. The Simplified-Regime threshold of 3,500 UVT gross income (COP 164,727,500 for 2024) and 6,500 UVT total assets (COP 305,922,500 for 2024) applies exclusively to natural persons and is unavailable to corporate entities; therefore VAT registration and e-invoicing activation are required before the first transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance through DIAN's Validación Previa model: every sales invoice must be generated in XML, transmitted via certified software or DIAN's free application using SOAP/REST APIs, and validated by DIAN before being deemed issued to the buyer. Each validated invoice obtains the CUDE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica), a QR/digital stamp evidencing fiscal authenticity, and must include the payment-rail reference (Stripe, Affirm BNPL, card or wire) in e-commerce metadata. Export sales must reference the associated DEX export declaration; non-compliant invoices are rejected (rechazo) before issuance, and failure to transmit or issue electronic invoices triggers monthly penalties of 1% of the invoice value per conduct (capped at 10,000 UVT) and audit-related suspension of the NIT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of portable battery generators and solar panels sold through direct online retail are excluded from IVA (effective 0%) under Article 481 of the Tax Statute, with full entitlement to credit and refund of input VAT, provided: (i) the S.A.S. is registered in the RUT with export status; (ii) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory under a DIAN-endorsed electronic export declaration (DEX), including simplified export declarations for postal or courier distance-selling channels; (iii) a Factura Electrónica de Exportación bearing a validated CUDE precedes the customs filing; (iv) the foreign buyer is genuinely located abroad, the sale is to a non-resident and the consideration is received in foreign currency through Colombia's authorized foreign-exchange market; and (v) the proof-of-export documentation is retained for at least five years. Digital/offshore services are separately excluded only when the Article 481 extraterritorial-use and foreign-exchange-channeling tests are met.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación Electrónica – DEX) accepted and closed by DIAN through the VUCE/Siglo XXI platform
Electronic Export Invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) bearing the DIAN CUDE and the DEX reference
Transport document evidencing departure from Colombian customs territory (ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, including international courier consignments)
Commercial packing list and cargo manifest (lista de empaque y manifiesto de carga) reconciled with the DEX
Foreign-exchange Declaration (Declaración de Cambio) or bank settlement certificate issued by a local intermediary evidencing actual collection of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN automatically cross-matches DEX customs records, CUDE e-invoice data and foreign-exchange settlement reports to detect fictitious, overstated or late-channeled exports. A denied or reversed zero-rating triggers: reassessment of the sale at 19% VAT; retroactive default interest (interés moratorio); the Article 648 inaccuracy penalty equal to 100% of the omitted VAT or of the improper refund (subject to the statutory reduction only for timely voluntary correction); compulsory clawback of all input-VAT refunds (saldo a favor) with indexation; loss of the exporter status and suspension of the NIT; and criminal exposure for contraband, fraudulent refunds and aggravated tax evasion (Criminal Code Articles 434 et seq. as amended by Law 2277 of 2022) against the S.A.S. and its legal representative. Repeat violations also lead to cancellation of the electronic-invoicing authorization and heightened transaction-level audits for all related marketing and logistics arrangements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) is the monetary and foreign-exchange authority; the foreign-exchange regime is governed by Law 9 of 1991 and External Resolution 8 of 2000 of the Banco de la República Board of Directors (Régimen de Cambios Internacionales), as amended by External Resolutions 113 of 2018 and 202 of 2019. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises the local authorized intermediaries (IMCs - Instituciones del Mercado Cambiario) that execute fx operations for residents, while DIAN provides the supporting customs documentation and tax verification framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a liberalized but strictly channeled floating-peso regime. Current-account transactions (export sales of portable solar generators and battery packs by an ISIC 4791 online retailer) are fully convertible through the Mercado Cambiario: foreign-currency card collections (Stripe/Affirm BNPL) may be received by the exporter and sold to an IMC for pesos without prior authorization, subject to the filing of the corresponding Exchange Declaration (Form 1). Capital-account transactions (inbound FDI and shareholder loans) are convertible but require a prior or contemporaneous international investment registration (Form 5) with Banco de la República, with the definitive registration due within 12 months of the inflow; unregistered capital loses the legal right to remit dividends and repatriate capital through the regulated banking system. There is no rationing, waiting list, or discretionary approval for genuine trade collections, but every inbound FX movement must be traceable to a declared causal code. Dividend and profit remittance to a non-resident shareholder of a Colombian S.A.S. is lawful once the registered capital is reported, the corporate financial statements are approved by the shareholders, and the DIAN dividend withholding payment is made.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods exporters must receive the export price within six (6) months from the customs departure date; any extension requires Banco de la República approval. Once the foreign currency is received, whether in Colombia or abroad, it must be channeled through the MCR, meaning the exporter must either (i) sell or convert the currency into COP through an IMC within two (2) business days after receipt, or (ii) credit the proceeds to a foreign-currency compensation account (cuenta de compensación) previously recognized by Banco de la República and use such funds only for the permitted purposes under the exchange regime. Colombia does NOT impose a percentage-based mandatory surrender ratio or an obligatory conversion quota for exporters: the exchange is made at the freely negotiated market rate and the exporter retains the full peso equivalent. Compliance is demonstrated through the IMC-filed Exchange Declaration (Form 1 - Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Bienes), and failure to channel funds within the legal terms exposes the company to SFC and Banco de la República administrative fines and potential loss of FX operating capacity.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Corporate Current Account (Cuenta Corriente Empresarial) in COP and an associated USD Foreign-Currency Compensation Account (cuenta de compensación) for export card settlements; the peso account serves as the principal liquidity and payroll clearing account.

Operational Peso Current Account plus a registered USD foreign-currency deposit account; suitable also as a staging account for the shareholder equity injection if the banc's compliance team requires segregation of paid-in capital prior to operational deployment.
Operational Current Account in COP with corporate e-commerce and card-acceptance focus; supports export FX declarations and compensation-account facilities for payment processors.
Operational Peso Current Account and trade-finance envelope (documentary Letters of Credit, import loans, supplier payables in USD); FX desk capabilities for the required MCR declarations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for the primary operating and FX-channeling treasury account; MEDIUM for non-core foreign-currency disbursement functions. Offshore digital EMI platforms (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Revolut Business, etc.) are not licensed by the SFC and are not authorized IMCs, so they cannot receive or settle FX movements on behalf of a Colombian resident without breaking the mandatory channeling rule; a Colombian e-commerce exporter would violate the exchange-control regime if card or export collections remained indefinitely outside the country in an unregistered non-bank e-money account. Their acceptable use is limited to (i) marginal reduction of FX friction for imports, (ii) supplier disbursement outside the MCR using already recognized compensation-account balances, or (iii) ancillary payment corridors where a regulated bank remains the final settlement point. Recommendation: route all Stripe/Affirm BNPL settlements directly or indirectly into the Colombian IMC account and use fintech rails only for low-value outbound vendor payments with a concurrent Form 2 import declaration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under SFC Circular 004 of 2020, remote on-boarding using videoconference, biometric facial authentication, and live identification against validated state registries is legally permissible, so physical presence is NOT a statutory precondition for opening a corporate bank account. Nonetheless, the majority of tier-1 Colombian banks apply a de facto policy requiring at least one in-person visit by the legal representative or the appointed Colombian resident attorney-in-fact to authenticate the signature card and complete the Sarlaft anti-money-laundering interview. A non-resident shareholder may remain abroad if the S.A.S. grants a notarized, apostilled power of attorney to a local representative and registers it with the Cámara de Comercio; the bank then processes the foreign documentation with Spanish translations and correspondent verification, adding approximately 5 to 10 business days to the KYC timeline. The pragmatic blueprint is to schedule a two-day Bogotá or Medellín branch visit for one authorized individual, which materially reduces clearing friction and accelerates the opening of the operational account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder chain opacity: the S.A.S. is owned by a foreign parent holding company or trust where ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) cannot be traced to natural persons.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete Sarlaft UBO matrix identifying every natural person with a direct or indirect interest above the Colombian 10% threshold; certified extract of the foreign parent corporate registry issued within the last 90 days; apostilled trust deed or full corporate chain translated into Spanish; signed attestation from all shareholders that no undisclosed beneficiary exists; and, if any UBO is a PEP, the bank's PEP questionnaire with source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border consumer e-commerce patterns: high velocity of card collections through Stripe and Affirm BNPL, chargeback volume, multi-currency receipts, and refund asymmetry creating a mismatch between declared turnover and a small local physical footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of PSP settlement statements and merchant dashboard extracts; trade-level export invoices; courier shipping manifests and customs transit records (DHL/FedEx); the public web store URL; refund and BNPL chargeback policy with provisioning ledger; and a treasury reconciliation memo evidencing alignment between gross revenue and channeled funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Director or legal representative residency in a FATF grey-listed or high-risk jurisdiction, non-resident signatories, or sanctions and PEP screening hits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled passport plus national identity document; official tax-residence certificate; professional biography and solicitor or employer reference letter; 12 to 18 months of personal bank statements evidencing legitimate wealth; executed consent to sanctions screening and PEP checks; and a sworn affidavit of unblemished financial and criminal history.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs surcharges of up to 1.5% per month on the registry fee, regulatory fines under Cámara de Comercio rules, and prolonged non-renewal may lead to administrative strike-off or cancellation of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros Anuales Aprobados y Acta de Asamblea de Accionistas (Annual Financial Statements and Shareholders' Meeting Minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio and corporate statutory minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual shareholders' meeting must be held by March 31; meeting minutes must be recorded in the statutory minute book within 30 days of the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve and record annual financial statements may trigger fines under Law 222/1995, impede the annual commercial registry renewal, and expose directors to liability for non-compliance with statutory accounting duties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Annual Confirmation / RUBF Update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (integrated with registry renewal) and DIAN (RUBF module)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31 with the mercantile renewal; DIAN RUBF annual updates follow the DIAN calendar, generally due before July 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or false UBO reporting may trigger DIAN fines (up to approximately COP 15 million) and increased AML/CFT scrutiny; failure to update after share transfers may result in UBO registry cancellation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: According to the DIAN national tax calendar, generally August 1 to September 21 for fiscal year-end December 31, based on NIT last digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of 5% of the tax due per month overdue, subject to a cap of 100%, plus default interest; repeated non-filing can escalate to tax lien measures and criminal tax liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian S.A.S. is mandatorily subject to statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) if gross assets exceed 5,000 times the Colombian legal monthly minimum wage (SMLMV) or gross revenues exceed 3,000 times SMLMV. This e-commerce entity is presumed to be below those thresholds and therefore exempt, unless a corporate by-law provision or shareholders' agreement requires an independent audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Ley 1314/2009. Small and mid-size entities, including this S.A.S., apply IFRS for SMEs (Grupo 2) unless classified in Grupo 1 or Grupo 3 by DIAN.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At least once per calendar year, the shareholders or sole shareholder must confirm the identity, nationality, and ownership percentage of all direct and indirect ultimate beneficial owners. The confirmation must be recorded in the company's internal shareholder register and, if any transfer occurred, filed in the DIAN RUBF module and reflected in the annual commercial registry renewal. A formal update must be submitted within 10 business days after any share transfer.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Registro de Accionistas (Register of Members)
Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas (Shareholders' Meeting Minute Book)
Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva (Board of Directors' Meeting Minute Book)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios, general corporate rate applicable to S.A.S. for taxable years 2022 onward; Tarifa Única under E.T. Art. 240).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No permanent general tax holiday. Relevant selective incentives: (i) Zona Franca regime at 20% for qualifying industrial/service users; (ii) 50% income-tax credit for investments in non-conventional renewable-energy projects (FNCER, Law 1715/2014), relevant to solar-portable-power retail via qualifying investment in solar equipment held for lease/fixed assets; (iii) deduction of up to 100% of certain R&D and environmental investments subject to statutory caps; (iv) SMEs below 3,500 UVT gross income may elect the SIMPLE regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) with turnover-based tax of 1.8%-14.5% (financial commerce generally ~2%-3.5%). Note: the historical 0%/25% 'new companies' CIT benefit (former Art. 240-1 E.T.) has been restricted by Ley 2277/2022.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_technical_note: Colombian S.A.S. taxpayers may carry tax losses ('pérdidas líquidas') forward indefinitely without a statutory expiry window. Annual offset is capped (generally at 50% of net taxable income of the offset year under E.T. Art. 147, as amended; special caps for specific periods apply to losses generated in 2022-2028). A value of 0 encodes 'unlimited carryforward' in this schema.
